retrievalProfile.description: A warm, sepia-toned portrait layout featuring a subject offset to the right against a textured parchment background with faint, illegible cursive script overlays.
excludeWhen: vibrant high-contrast neon styles are requested
modern minimalist flat design is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a male subject positioned on the right third of the frame, looking off-camera. The background is a warm, aged yellow-brown parchment texture featuring faint horizontal lines and ghosted layers of cursive handwriting. The lighting is soft and directional, casting gentle shadows. Typography is placed in the lower third, spanning across the subject and the negative space.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject offset to the right creates a balance with the textured negative space on the left.
Warm sepia color palette unifies the subject's clothing and the background parchment.
Faint script texture provides a narrative depth without distracting from the primary subject.
Wide-tracked typography anchors the bottom of the composition.
coreInvariants: Aged parchment texture with visible grain and stains
Ghosted cursive handwriting in the background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up, positioned on the right side, occupying approximately 40% of the horizontal frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bold, wide-tracked text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eyes, moves down to the text, then sweeps left across the textured background script.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space on the left, filled with parchment texture and faint writing.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm beige and tan (background and skin tones)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark brown and charcoal (clothing stripes and shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, medium to high value with soft contrast.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid primary blues, greens, or reds
Stick to earth tones and sepia variations

treatment.fill: solid black or very dark brown

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used with extreme tracking for elegance.

avoid: Serif fonts for the main name

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean, geometric structure and looks excellent with wide tracking.
A versatile alternative with similar geometric proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man with shaggy hair in a striped shirt, positioned on the right side of the frame. The background should be a warm, aged parchment paper with faint horizontal lines and ghosted, illegible cursive handwriting. Apply a sepia-toned, soft-focus filter.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist's name in the lower third using an uppercase geometric sans-serif font. Use very wide tracking so the name spans across the width of the image, partially overlapping the subject's chest.

verificationChecks: Is the subject positioned to the right?
Is the background a textured parchment with faint script?
Is the text uppercase with wide tracking?
Is the overall color palette warm and sepia-toned?

adjustableVariables: Amount of tracking in the typography
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original person

mustAchieve: Soft, flattering lighting on the subject

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the background and subject.
Verify the parchment texture doesn't look like a low-resolution repeat.
Check that the sepia tone is consistent across the subject and background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject(Right) + Parchment(Script Texture) + Sans-Serif(Wide Tracking) = Rustic Singer-Songwriter Aesthetic
